title: Clinical Staging Tools for the Impacts of Obesity on Individuals
brief_summary: This study will assess various published staging tools to assess the health impacts of obesity on individuals. The aim is to identify benefits and drawbacks, and thus help Obesity Centres and GPs better assess obese individuals as well as better identify who benefits most from having weight loss treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Morbid obesity
* At least 1 year follow-up after bariatric surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
study_population: Individuals with BMI \> 40 or \>35 and a obesity-related medical condition
